professionalSummary.text: Four years of experience as a Software Engineer on the warehouse control system team at a retail distribution company, implementing control system changes against operations specifications under the team's software standard.
professionalSummary.witness: Software engineer on the warehouse control system team of a retail distribution company for four years, implementing control system changes against the operations specialists' specifications under the team's software standard; forty-four changes in the period, each on a change record in my name.

professionalSummary.text: Documented forty-four control system changes, each with a test record attached to the change record and verified by a second engineer.
professionalSummary.witness: Tested each change on the emulation rig with the test record attached to the change record and checked by a second engineer.

professionalSummary.text: Managed the software review process for all changes, with release approval recorded as the control system lead's responsibility.
professionalSummary.witness: Took each change through the software review process; the release approval was the control system lead's, recorded on the change record.

professionalSummary.text: Supported three distribution centres' support desks with diagnostics, recording incident ownership and vendor handoffs.
professionalSummary.witness: Supported the three distribution centres' support desks with diagnostics through the support queue, recording which incidents I diagnosed and which were passed to the automation vendor.

professionalSummary.text: Documented change limitations and hand-over conditions in the change record's closure section for all forty-four changes.
professionalSummary.witness: Wrote the limitation note and the hand-over conditions of each change in the change record's closure section.

skills.text: Warehouse control system implementation, emulation rig testing, software review process management, diagnostic support, and change documentation.
skills.witness: Software engineer on the warehouse control system team of a retail distribution company for four years, implementing control system changes against the operations specialists' specifications under the team's software standard; forty-four changes in the period, each on a change record in my name. Tested each change on the emulation rig with the test record attached to the change record and checked by a second engineer. Took each change through the software review process; the release approval was the control system lead's, recorded on the change record. Supported the three distribution centres' support desks with diagnostics through the support queue, recording which incidents I diagnosed and which were passed to the automation vendor. Wrote the limitation note and the hand-over conditions of each change in the change record's closure section.
